verses.text: lest the friend reproach you, and your battle and enmity not depart, but be for you equal to death.
verses.display_text: lest the friend reproach you, and your battle and enmity not depart, but be for you equal to death.

verses.text: Favor and friendship set one free; keep these for yourself so that you do not become subject to reproach, but guard your ways with readiness to be reconciled.
verses.display_text: Favor and friendship set one free; keep these for yourself so that you do not become subject to reproach, but guard your ways with readiness to be reconciled.

verses.text: A golden apple on a carnelian necklace—so is speaking a word.
verses.display_text: A golden apple on a carnelian necklace—so is speaking a word.

verses.text: A costly carnelian is fastened into a golden earring—a wise word into a receptive ear.
verses.display_text: A costly carnelian is fastened into a golden earring—a wise word into a receptive ear.

verses.text: As snow coming forth benefits people in harvest heat, so a faithful messenger benefits those who sent him; for he benefits the lives of those who employ him.
verses.display_text: As snow coming forth benefits people in harvest heat, so a faithful messenger benefits those who sent him; for he benefits the lives of those who employ him.

verses.text: Like winds and clouds and very conspicuous rains, so are those who boast of a false gift.
verses.display_text: Like winds and clouds and very conspicuous rains, so are those who boast of a false gift.

verses.text: In patience is prosperity for kings, and a soft tongue crushes bones.
verses.display_text: In patience is prosperity for kings, and a soft tongue crushes bones.

verses.text: Having found honey, eat what is sufficient, lest you become full and vomit.
verses.display_text: Having found honey, eat what is sufficient, lest you become full and vomit.

verses.text: Bring your foot rarely to your own friend, lest he become filled with you and hate you.
verses.display_text: Bring your foot rarely to your own friend, lest he become filled with you and hate you.

verses.text: A club and sword and barbed arrow—so also is a man testifying false testimony against his friend.
verses.display_text: A club and sword and barbed arrow—so also is a man testifying false testimony against his friend.

verses.text: An evil person’s tooth and a lawless person’s foot will perish on an evil day.
verses.display_text: An evil person’s tooth and a lawless person’s foot will perish on an evil day.

verses.text: As vinegar is unsuitable for a wound, so a suffering that falls upon the body pains the heart.
verses.display_text: As vinegar is unsuitable for a wound, so a suffering that falls upon the body pains the heart.

verses.text: As a moth harms a garment and a worm wood, so a man’s grief harms the heart.
verses.display_text: As a moth harms a garment and a worm wood, so a man’s grief harms the heart.

verses.text: If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink;
verses.display_text: If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink;

verses.text: for by doing this you will heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord will repay you good things.
verses.display_text: for by doing this you will heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord will repay you good things.

verses.text: A north wind raises clouds, but a shameless face provokes a tongue.
verses.display_text: A north wind raises clouds, but a shameless face provokes a tongue.

verses.text: Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with an abusive wife in a shared house.
verses.display_text: Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with an abusive wife in a shared house.

verses.text: As cold water is welcome to a thirsty life, so is good news from a faraway land.
verses.display_text: As cold water is welcome to a thirsty life, so is good news from a faraway land.

verses.text: As if someone blocked a spring and ruined an outlet of water, so it is disorderly for a righteous person to have fallen before the impious.
verses.display_text: As if someone blocked a spring and ruined an outlet of water, so it is disorderly for a righteous person to have fallen before the impious.

verses.text: Eating much honey is not good, but one must honor glorious words.
verses.display_text: Eating much honey is not good, but one must honor glorious words.

verses.text: As a city with its walls cast down and unwalled, so is a man who does something without counsel.
verses.display_text: As a city with its walls cast down and unwalled, so is a man who does something without counsel.

verses.text: Like dew at harvest and rain in summer, so honor does not belong to a fool.
verses.display_text: Like dew at harvest and rain in summer, so honor does not belong to a fool.

verses.text: As birds and sparrows fly, so an empty curse will come upon no one.
verses.display_text: As birds and sparrows fly, so an empty curse will come upon no one.

verses.text: As a whip for a horse and a goad for a donkey, so a rod for a lawless nation.
verses.display_text: As a whip for a horse and a goad for a donkey, so a rod for a lawless nation.

verses.text: Do not answer a fool in relation to his foolishness, so that you do not become like him;
verses.display_text: Do not answer a fool in relation to his foolishness, so that you do not become like him;

verses.text: but answer a fool according to his foolishness, so that he does not appear wise to himself.
verses.display_text: but answer a fool according to his foolishness, so that he does not appear wise to himself.

verses.text: One who sends a word through a foolish messenger will drink reproach from his own feet.
verses.display_text: One who sends a word through a foolish messenger will drink reproach from his own feet.

verses.text: Remove walking from legs, and a proverb from the mouth of fools.
verses.display_text: Remove walking from legs, and a proverb from the mouth of fools.

verses.text: One who binds a stone in a sling is like one who gives glory to a fool.
verses.display_text: One who binds a stone in a sling is like one who gives glory to a fool.

verses.text: Thorns grow in the hand of the drunkard, but slavery is in the hand of fools.
verses.display_text: Thorns grow in the hand of the drunkard, but slavery is in the hand of fools.

verses.text: All the flesh of fools is greatly storm-tossed, for their distraction is shattered.
verses.display_text: All the flesh of fools is greatly storm-tossed, for their distraction is shattered.

verses.text: Like a dog that comes upon its own vomit and becomes hateful is a fool who has returned in his own wickedness to his own sin.
verses.display_text: Like a dog that comes upon its own vomit and becomes hateful is a fool who has returned in his own wickedness to his own sin.

verses.text: There is shame that brings on sin, and there is shame that is glory and favor.
verses.display_text: There is shame that brings on sin, and there is shame that is glory and favor.

verses.text: I saw a man who thought himself wise, yet a fool had more hope than he.
verses.display_text: I saw a man who thought himself wise, yet a fool had more hope than he.

verses.text: A lazy person sent on a journey says, “A lion is in the roads!”
verses.display_text: A lazy person sent on a journey says, “A lion is in the roads!”

verses.text: As a door turns on its hinge, so a lazy person on his bed.
verses.display_text: As a door turns on its hinge, so a lazy person on his bed.

verses.text: A lazy person, having hidden his hand in his lap, will not be able to bring it to his mouth.
verses.display_text: A lazy person, having hidden his hand in his lap, will not be able to bring it to his mouth.

verses.text: The lazy person appears wiser to himself than one who brings back a message in full.
verses.display_text: The lazy person appears wiser to himself than one who brings back a message in full.

verses.text: As one who grasps a dog’s tail, so is one who presides over another’s dispute.
verses.display_text: As one who grasps a dog’s tail, so is one who presides over another’s dispute.

verses.text: As healers put forward words to people, and the first to meet the word will be tripped up,
verses.display_text: As healers put forward words to people, and the first to meet the word will be tripped up,

verses.text: so are all who ambush their own friends, and when detected say, “I did it in play.”
verses.display_text: so are all who ambush their own friends, and when detected say, “I did it in play.”

verses.text: With much wood a fire flourishes, but where there is no double-minded person, battle is quiet.
verses.display_text: With much wood a fire flourishes, but where there is no double-minded person, battle is quiet.

verses.text: A hearth for coals and wood for fire, and an abusive man for the turmoil of battle.
verses.display_text: A hearth for coals and wood for fire, and an abusive man for the turmoil of battle.

verses.text: The words of tricksters are soft, but they strike into the store-chambers of the inward parts.
verses.display_text: The words of tricksters are soft, but they strike into the store-chambers of the inward parts.

verses.text: Silver given with deceit must be regarded like a potsherd; smooth lips cover a painful heart.
verses.display_text: Silver given with deceit must be regarded like a potsherd; smooth lips cover a painful heart.

verses.text: A weeping enemy agrees to everything with his lips, but in his heart devises deceits;
verses.display_text: A weeping enemy agrees to everything with his lips, but in his heart devises deceits;

verses.text: if the enemy entreats you with a loud voice, do not be persuaded, for seven evils are in his life.
verses.display_text: if the enemy entreats you with a loud voice, do not be persuaded, for seven evils are in his life.

verses.text: One who hides enmity establishes deceit, but one well known in councils discloses his own sins.
verses.display_text: One who hides enmity establishes deceit, but one well known in councils discloses his own sins.

verses.text: One who digs a pit for his neighbor will fall into it, and one who rolls a stone rolls it upon himself.
verses.display_text: One who digs a pit for his neighbor will fall into it, and one who rolls a stone rolls it upon himself.

verses.text: A false tongue hates truth, but an unrestrained mouth makes disorders.
verses.display_text: A false tongue hates truth, but an unrestrained mouth makes disorders.

verses.text: Do not boast of things for tomorrow, for you do not know what the coming day will bear.
verses.display_text: Do not boast of things for tomorrow, for you do not know what the coming day will bear.

verses.text: Let your neighbor praise you, and not your mouth, another, and not your lips.
verses.display_text: Let your neighbor praise you, and not your mouth, another, and not your lips.

verses.text: A stone is heavy and sand hard to carry, but a fool’s anger is heavier than both.
verses.display_text: A stone is heavy and sand hard to carry, but a fool’s anger is heavier than both.

verses.text: Wrath is merciless and anger sharp, but jealousy bears with no one.
verses.display_text: Wrath is merciless and anger sharp, but jealousy bears with no one.

verses.text: Open rebukes are better than concealed friendship.
verses.display_text: Open rebukes are better than concealed friendship.

verses.text: A friend’s wounds are more trustworthy than an enemy’s willing kisses.
verses.display_text: A friend’s wounds are more trustworthy than an enemy’s willing kisses.

verses.text: A life in fullness mocks honeycombs, but to a needy life even bitter things seem sweet.
verses.display_text: A life in fullness mocks honeycombs, but to a needy life even bitter things seem sweet.

verses.text: As when a bird flies down from its own nest, so a person is enslaved when estranged from his own places.
verses.display_text: As when a bird flies down from its own nest, so a person is enslaved when estranged from his own places.

verses.text: The heart delights in perfumes and wines and incense, but the life is torn apart by misfortunes.
verses.display_text: The heart delights in perfumes and wines and incense, but the life is torn apart by misfortunes.

verses.text: Do not abandon your friend or an ancestral friend, and do not enter your brother’s house when misfortune strikes you; a nearby friend is better than a brother dwelling far away.
verses.display_text: Do not abandon your friend or an ancestral friend, and do not enter your brother’s house when misfortune strikes you; a nearby friend is better than a brother dwelling far away.

verses.text: Become wise, son, so that my heart may rejoice, and turn reproachful words away from yourself.
verses.display_text: Become wise, son, so that my heart may rejoice, and turn reproachful words away from yourself.

verses.text: A resourceful person hid when evils approached, but fools who went on will pay a penalty.
verses.display_text: A resourceful person hid when evils approached, but fools who went on will pay a penalty.

verses.text: Take away his garment, for he has transgressed; one who ruins another’s property is insolent.
verses.display_text: Take away his garment, for he has transgressed; one who ruins another’s property is insolent.

verses.text: One who blesses a friend early with a loud voice will seem no different from one cursing.
verses.display_text: One who blesses a friend early with a loud voice will seem no different from one cursing.

verses.text: Drops drive a man from his house on a wintry day, and likewise an abusive wife from his own house.
verses.display_text: Drops drive a man from his house on a wintry day, and likewise an abusive wife from his own house.

verses.text: The north wind is a harsh wind, but by name it is called favorable.
verses.display_text: The north wind is a harsh wind, but by name it is called favorable.

verses.text: Iron sharpens iron, but a man provokes the face of a companion.
verses.display_text: Iron sharpens iron, but a man provokes the face of a companion.

verses.text: One who plants a fig tree will eat its fruits, and one who guards his own master will be honored.
verses.display_text: One who plants a fig tree will eat its fruits, and one who guards his own master will be honored.

verses.text: As faces are not like faces, so neither are human hearts.
verses.display_text: As faces are not like faces, so neither are human hearts.

verses.text: Hades and destruction are not filled, and likewise human eyes are insatiable.
verses.display_text: Hades and destruction are not filled, and likewise human eyes are insatiable.

verses.text: One who fixes an eye is an abomination to the Lord, and the uneducated are unrestrained in tongue.
verses.display_text: One who fixes an eye is an abomination to the Lord, and the uneducated are unrestrained in tongue.

verses.text: A test for silver and gold is burning, but a man is tested through the mouth of those who praise him.
verses.display_text: A test for silver and gold is burning, but a man is tested through the mouth of those who praise him.

verses.text: A lawless person’s heart searches out evils, but an upright heart searches out knowledge.
verses.display_text: A lawless person’s heart searches out evils, but an upright heart searches out knowledge.

verses.text: If you whip a fool in the midst of a council, dishonoring him, you will certainly not strip away his foolishness.
verses.display_text: If you whip a fool in the midst of a council, dishonoring him, you will certainly not strip away his foolishness.

verses.text: Know thoroughly the lives of your flock, and set your heart upon your herds;
verses.display_text: Know thoroughly the lives of your flock, and set your heart upon your herds;

verses.text: for a man’s might and strength do not last for ever, nor does he hand them on from generation to generation.
verses.display_text: for a man’s might and strength do not last for ever, nor does he hand them on from generation to generation.

verses.text: Care for the green growth in the plain, and you will cut grass, and gather mountain fodder,
verses.display_text: Care for the green growth in the plain, and you will cut grass, and gather mountain fodder,

verses.text: so that you may have sheep for clothing; value a plain, so that you may have lambs.
verses.display_text: so that you may have sheep for clothing; value a plain, so that you may have lambs.

verses.text: Son, from me you have strong sayings for your life, and for the life of your attendants.
verses.display_text: Son, from me you have strong sayings for your life, and for the life of your attendants.

verses.text: An impious person flees when no one pursues, but a righteous person is confident like a lion.
verses.display_text: An impious person flees when no one pursues, but a righteous person is confident like a lion.

verses.text: Through the sins of the impious, disputes arise, but a prudent man will extinguish them.
verses.display_text: Through the sins of the impious, disputes arise, but a prudent man will extinguish them.

verses.text: A man vigorous in impieties extorts the poor. Just like a violent and useless rain,
verses.display_text: A man vigorous in impieties extorts the poor. Just like a violent and useless rain,

verses.text: so those who abandon the law praise impiety, but those who love the law surround themselves with a wall.
verses.display_text: so those who abandon the law praise impiety, but those who love the law surround themselves with a wall.

verses.text: Evil men will not understand judgment, but those who seek the Lord will understand in everything.
verses.display_text: Evil men will not understand judgment, but those who seek the Lord will understand in everything.

verses.text: Better a poor person walking in truth than a lying rich person.
verses.display_text: Better a poor person walking in truth than a lying rich person.

verses.text: An understanding son keeps the law, but one who tends dissipation dishonors a father.
verses.display_text: An understanding son keeps the law, but one who tends dissipation dishonors a father.

verses.text: One who increases his wealth with interest and gains gathers it for one who shows mercy to the poor.
verses.display_text: One who increases his wealth with interest and gains gathers it for one who shows mercy to the poor.

verses.text: One who turns his ear aside so as not to hear the law has himself also abhorred his own prayer.
verses.display_text: One who turns his ear aside so as not to hear the law has himself also abhorred his own prayer.

verses.text: One who leads the upright astray on an evil way will himself fall into destruction; but the lawless will pass by good things and will not enter into them.
verses.display_text: One who leads the upright astray on an evil way will himself fall into destruction; but the lawless will pass by good things and will not enter into them.

verses.text: A rich man is wise in his own estimation, but an intelligent poor person will judge him.
verses.display_text: A rich man is wise in his own estimation, but an intelligent poor person will judge him.

verses.text: Through the help of the righteous much glory comes about, but in the places of the impious people are captured.
verses.display_text: Through the help of the righteous much glory comes about, but in the places of the impious people are captured.

verses.text: One who covers his own impiety will not prosper, but one who explains reproofs will be loved.
verses.display_text: One who covers his own impiety will not prosper, but one who explains reproofs will be loved.

verses.text: Happy is a man who shrinks from everything out of reverence, but one hard of heart will fall into evils.
verses.display_text: Happy is a man who shrinks from everything out of reverence, but one hard of heart will fall into evils.

verses.text: One who tyrannizes over a needy nation while himself poor is a hungry lion and a thirsty wolf.
verses.display_text: One who tyrannizes over a needy nation while himself poor is a hungry lion and a thirsty wolf.

verses.text: A king lacking revenues is a great extortioner, but one who hates injustice will live a long time.
verses.display_text: A king lacking revenues is a great extortioner, but one who hates injustice will live a long time.

verses.text: One who acts as guarantor for a man charged with murder will be a fugitive and will not be secure.
verses.display_text: One who acts as guarantor for a man charged with murder will be a fugitive and will not be secure.

verses.text: Discipline a son, and he will love you and give adornment to your life; you must not heed a lawless nation.
verses.display_text: Discipline a son, and he will love you and give adornment to your life; you must not heed a lawless nation.

verses.text: One who walks righteously has been helped, but one who walks crooked ways will become entangled.
verses.display_text: One who walks righteously has been helped, but one who walks crooked ways will become entangled.

verses.text: One who works his own land will be filled with bread, but one who pursues leisure will be filled with poverty.
verses.display_text: One who works his own land will be filled with bread, but one who pursues leisure will be filled with poverty.

verses.text: A trustworthy man will be greatly blessed, but the evil person will not be unpunished.
verses.display_text: A trustworthy man will be greatly blessed, but the evil person will not be unpunished.

verses.text: One who has no respect for the faces of the righteous is not good; such a person will sell a man for a morsel of bread.
verses.display_text: One who has no respect for the faces of the righteous is not good; such a person will sell a man for a morsel of bread.

verses.text: A grudging man hastens to become rich and does not know that a merciful person will rule over him.
verses.display_text: A grudging man hastens to become rich and does not know that a merciful person will rule over him.

verses.text: One who reproves a person’s ways will have more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.display_text: One who reproves a person’s ways will have more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

verses.text: One who casts away a father or mother and thinks he is not sinning is a partner of an impious man.
verses.display_text: One who casts away a father or mother and thinks he is not sinning is a partner of an impious man.

verses.text: An insatiable man judges rashly, but one who trusts in the Lord will be cared for.
verses.display_text: An insatiable man judges rashly, but one who trusts in the Lord will be cared for.

verses.text: One who trusts in a rash heart is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom will be saved.
verses.display_text: One who trusts in a rash heart is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom will be saved.

verses.text: One who gives to the poor will not be in need; but one who turns away his eye will be in great difficulty.
verses.display_text: One who gives to the poor will not be in need; but one who turns away his eye will be in great difficulty.

verses.text: In the places of the impious the righteous groan, but at their destruction the righteous will multiply.
verses.display_text: In the places of the impious the righteous groan, but at their destruction the righteous will multiply.

verses.text: Better a man who reproves than a stiff-necked man; for when the latter suddenly burns, there is no healing.
verses.display_text: Better a man who reproves than a stiff-necked man; for when the latter suddenly burns, there is no healing.

verses.text: When the righteous are praised, peoples will rejoice; but when the impious rule, men groan.
verses.display_text: When the righteous are praised, peoples will rejoice; but when the impious rule, men groan.

verses.text: When a man loves wisdom, his father rejoices; but one who tends prostitutes will destroy wealth.
verses.display_text: When a man loves wisdom, his father rejoices; but one who tends prostitutes will destroy wealth.

verses.text: A righteous king raises up a country, but a lawless man tears it down.
verses.display_text: A righteous king raises up a country, but a lawless man tears it down.

verses.text: One who prepares a net before his own friend’s face wraps it around his own feet.
verses.display_text: One who prepares a net before his own friend’s face wraps it around his own feet.

verses.text: For a sinning man there is a great snare, but a righteous person will be in joy and gladness.
verses.display_text: For a sinning man there is a great snare, but a righteous person will be in joy and gladness.

verses.text: A righteous person knows how to judge for the needy, but the impious person will not understand knowledge, and a poor person has no discerning mind.
verses.display_text: A righteous person knows how to judge for the needy, but the impious person will not understand knowledge, and a poor person has no discerning mind.

verses.text: Pestilent men set a city ablaze, but wise people turned away wrath.
verses.display_text: Pestilent men set a city ablaze, but wise people turned away wrath.

verses.text: A wise man judges nations, but a worthless man who becomes angry is laughed at and does not shrink back.
verses.display_text: A wise man judges nations, but a worthless man who becomes angry is laughed at and does not shrink back.

verses.text: Men sharing in bloodshed will hate a holy person, but the upright will seek his life.
verses.display_text: Men sharing in bloodshed will hate a holy person, but the upright will seek his life.

verses.text: A fool brings out all his anger, but a wise person stores it up portion by portion.
verses.display_text: A fool brings out all his anger, but a wise person stores it up portion by portion.

verses.text: When a king listens to an unjust word, all those under him are lawless.
verses.display_text: When a king listens to an unjust word, all those under him are lawless.

verses.text: When lender and debtor come together, the Lord inspects both.
verses.display_text: When lender and debtor come together, the Lord inspects both.

verses.text: When a king judges the poor in truth, his throne will be established as a testimony.
verses.display_text: When a king judges the poor in truth, his throne will be established as a testimony.

verses.text: Blows and reproofs give wisdom, but a wandering child shames his parents.
verses.display_text: Blows and reproofs give wisdom, but a wandering child shames his parents.

verses.text: When the impious are many, sins become many, but the righteous become terrified when those people fall.
verses.display_text: When the impious are many, sins become many, but the righteous become terrified when those people fall.

verses.text: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest and give adornment to your life.
verses.display_text: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest and give adornment to your life.

verses.text: There will certainly be no interpreter for a lawless nation, but one who keeps the law is blessed.
verses.display_text: There will certainly be no interpreter for a lawless nation, but one who keeps the law is blessed.

verses.text: A harsh household servant will not be disciplined by words; for even if he understands, he will not obey.
verses.display_text: A harsh household servant will not be disciplined by words; for even if he understands, he will not obey.

verses.text: If you see a man swift in words, know that a fool has more hope than he.
verses.display_text: If you see a man swift in words, know that a fool has more hope than he.

verses.text: One who lives extravagantly from childhood will become a household servant, and in the end he will grieve over himself.
verses.display_text: One who lives extravagantly from childhood will become a household servant, and in the end he will grieve over himself.

verses.text: A wrathful man digs up strife, and an angry man dug out sins.
verses.display_text: A wrathful man digs up strife, and an angry man dug out sins.

verses.text: Insolence brings a man low, but the Lord supports the humble-minded with glory.
verses.display_text: Insolence brings a man low, but the Lord supports the humble-minded with glory.

verses.text: One who shares with a thief hates his own life; but if, when an oath is set before them, those who heard do not report,
verses.display_text: One who shares with a thief hates his own life; but if, when an oath is set before them, those who heard do not report,

verses.text: having feared and felt shame before people, they were tripped up; but one who trusts in the Lord will rejoice. Impiety gives a man a fall; but one who trusts in the Master will be saved.
verses.display_text: having feared and felt shame before people, they were tripped up; but one who trusts in the Lord will rejoice. Impiety gives a man a fall; but one who trusts in the Master will be saved.

verses.text: Many court the faces of leaders, but what is just for a man comes from the Lord.
verses.display_text: Many court the faces of leaders, but what is just for a man comes from the Lord.

verses.text: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, but a straightening way is an abomination to a lawless person.
verses.display_text: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, but a straightening way is an abomination to a lawless person.

verses.text: A courageous woman—who will find her? Such a woman is more precious than costly stones.
verses.display_text: A courageous woman—who will find her? Such a woman is more precious than costly stones.

verses.text: Her husband’s heart is confident in her; such a woman will not lack fine spoils.
verses.display_text: Her husband’s heart is confident in her; such a woman will not lack fine spoils.

verses.text: For she works good things for her husband throughout her life.
verses.display_text: For she works good things for her husband throughout her life.

verses.text: Spinning wool and flax, she made useful work with her hands.
verses.display_text: Spinning wool and flax, she made useful work with her hands.

verses.text: She became like a ship trading from afar, and she gathers her livelihood.
verses.display_text: She became like a ship trading from afar, and she gathers her livelihood.

verses.text: And she rises in the night and gave food to the household and tasks to the maidservants.
verses.display_text: And she rises in the night and gave food to the household and tasks to the maidservants.

verses.text: After inspecting a farm she bought it, and from the fruits of her hands she planted an estate.
verses.display_text: After inspecting a farm she bought it, and from the fruits of her hands she planted an estate.

verses.text: Having girded her waist strongly, she braced her arms for work.
verses.display_text: Having girded her waist strongly, she braced her arms for work.

verses.text: She tasted that working is good, and her lamp is not extinguished throughout the night.
verses.display_text: She tasted that working is good, and her lamp is not extinguished throughout the night.

verses.text: She stretches her forearms toward profitable things, and braces her hands on a spindle.
verses.display_text: She stretches her forearms toward profitable things, and braces her hands on a spindle.

verses.text: She opened her hands to a needy person and stretched out her wrist to a poor person.
verses.display_text: She opened her hands to a needy person and stretched out her wrist to a poor person.

verses.text: Her husband is not anxious about those at home when he stays away somewhere, for all those with her are clothed.
verses.display_text: Her husband is not anxious about those at home when he stays away somewhere, for all those with her are clothed.

verses.text: She made double cloaks for her husband, and garments of fine linen and purple for herself.
verses.display_text: She made double cloaks for her husband, and garments of fine linen and purple for herself.

verses.text: Her husband becomes distinguished in the gates when he sits in council with the elder inhabitants of the land.
verses.display_text: Her husband becomes distinguished in the gates when he sits in council with the elder inhabitants of the land.

verses.text: She made linen cloths and sold them, and girdles for the Canaanites.
verses.display_text: She made linen cloths and sold them, and girdles for the Canaanites.

verses.text: She opened her mouth attentively and lawfully and prescribed order for her tongue.
verses.display_text: She opened her mouth attentively and lawfully and prescribed order for her tongue.

verses.text: She clothed herself in strength and dignity and rejoiced in the last days.
verses.display_text: She clothed herself in strength and dignity and rejoiced in the last days.

verses.text: The occupations of her houses are secure, and she did not eat idle food.
verses.display_text: The occupations of her houses are secure, and she did not eat idle food.

verses.text: She opens her mouth wisely and according to law, and her mercy raised up her children, and they became wealthy, and her husband praised her:
verses.display_text: She opens her mouth wisely and according to law, and her mercy raised up her children, and they became wealthy, and her husband praised her:

verses.text: “Many daughters acquired wealth, many did mighty things, but you stand above and have surpassed them all.”
verses.display_text: “Many daughters acquired wealth, many did mighty things, but you stand above and have surpassed them all.”

verses.text: A woman’s pleasing qualities are false and beauty is vain; for an understanding woman is blessed, and let her praise the fear of the Lord.
verses.display_text: A woman’s pleasing qualities are false and beauty is vain; for an understanding woman is blessed, and let her praise the fear of the Lord.

verses.text: Give her from the fruits of her hands, and let her husband be praised in the gates.
verses.display_text: Give her from the fruits of her hands, and let her husband be praised in the gates.
